function.arguments: {"reflection":"The evidence is intentionally narrow: the dossier identifies a single aggregated experimental trajectory from a 2D array (111 active units), and the CSV supplies 2199 sequential samples at 300 Hz. It is not 2199 independent observations. The width is a correlation-length proxy, while its normalized reciprocal has Infinity because at least one width is zero; this is a data-quality/transform caveat, not a physical infinite wave number. Need characterize robust broad temporal phases and co-movement without causal or inferential overreach. No memory files existed. No matching research skills beyond generic skill discovery/creation, so direct analysis is appropriate."}
